name: A Supernatural Device
summary: In Gadgetzan, Mokvar sends you with venom for an engineer studying the dead. Mux Manascrambler is building a device to speak with them, and Mokvar hopes it can reach Anthion.

sections.title: Venom for an Engineer
sections.body: Mokvar says you have shown courage by staying on, and more armor awaits those still willing to help. The venom you gathered is for Mux Manascrambler, an engineer who studies the supernatural and knows Mokvar. Mux is building a device to speak with the dead. Mokvar hopes it can reach Anthion and reveal more about his own situation. Carry the sealed container to Mux in Gadgetzan, in Tanaris.

sections.title: A Welcome Delivery
sections.body: Mux Manascrambler is glad to receive the venom because the supply was running low. Then Mux asks whether Mokvar sent you.

faq.q: Who is sending you on this delivery?
faq.answer: Mokvar sends you with a sealed container of venom to an acquaintance in Gadgetzan.

faq.q: Where does the venom need to go?
aliases: where do i take the venom
faq.answer: The venom goes to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan, in Tanaris.
Mux Manascrambler is an engineer fascinated by the supernatural and an acquaintance of Mokvar.
Mux is building a device that lets people speak with the dead. It is his latest project.

faq.q: Why does Mokvar want to reach the dead?
faq.answer: Mokvar hopes the device can reach Anthion and reveal more about his own situation. He sees it as a final chance.

angles.text: Mokvar sends Horde adventurers to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.
